facts.text: Caroline is planning an LGBTQ art show with her paintings, scheduled for next month.

evidence.quote: Next month I'm having an LGBTQ art show with my paintings - can't wait!

facts.text: Caroline shared a photo of a painting with a blue and yellow design as a preview for her upcoming art show.

evidence.quote: Can't wait to see your art - got any previews?
Check out my painting for the art show! Hope you like it.

facts.text: Caroline painted the art show preview after visiting an LGBTQ center, aiming to capture unity and strength within the community.

evidence.quote: I painted this after I visited a LGBTQ center. I wanted to capture everyone's unity and strength.
